item.title: Scala self-recursive types
item.description: One of the advantages of using a statically typed language is that you can use the type system to enforce some constraints. Scala provides self-recursive types, aka F-bounded polymorphic types that—along with self types—let you impose powerful constraints on your type definitions. Self-recursive…
